description: Subscribe a wallet to push notifications (order_filled / offer_received / saved_search) via an HMAC-signed webhook — the agent-native alternative to polling. Two-step: call WITHOUT `signature` to get the exact message to sign (EIP-191 personal_sign), then call again WITH the signature. `chainId` is signed over and the signature is verified on THAT chain, so pass the chain the wallet actually signs on (smart-wallet signatures do not validate cross-chain). Each signed message is SINGLE-USE: resending the same body returns 409 replayed_signature — retry with a fresh timestamp and a new signature. The response includes the webhook HMAC secret ONCE (verify x-market0x-signature = hex(HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, secret))).

chainId.description: chain the wallet signs on; it is part of the signed message

nameContains.description: name markets: substring match on listed names

signature.description: EIP-191 signature of the canonical message; omit to receive the message to sign

timestamp.description: unix seconds; must be within 10 minutes of now

webhookUrl.description: https URL; required for the webhook channel

name: subscribe_notifications
